label: Teacher communicates learning objectives with the class.
Teacher selects appropriate learning strategies, learning activities and resources.
Teacher develops a workable/appropriate time schedule.
Teacher uses appropriate resources (ICT, media, etc.) effectively.
Teacher provides opportunities for real-life application.
Teacher makes relevant connections to students' previous experiences.
Teacher is responsive to feedback and includes students' ideas.
Teacher arranges collaborative opportunities and manages them.
Teacher sets and enforces rules/routines effectively.
Teacher establishes a supportive learning environment.
Teacher uses voice and language appropriately.
Teacher allows flexibility and choice in tasks.
Students are able to ask well-thought questions.
Teacher provides enough wait time for students to respond.
Teacher provides timely, specific and meaningful feedback.
The content of the lesson is relevant to requirements.
Students are able to comprehend the lesson content.
